reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I’ve played this game for a few years and loved it but it’s changed drastically and not in a good way. The items have become extremely expensive and the “voting” results do not reflect the amount of money/gems spent. The shop is cluttered with player-made items that are of very bad quality. There’s too many events going on at once. The exclusive items are all the same, just different colors. The hairstyles are basic; there’s a lot of long hairstyles, no ponytails, buns, or rollups, or cuts. The avatars are unattractive, specifically the ones with ethnic backgrounds. And, even when played daily, it takes years to reach a new level. I went from a VIP membership to playing occasionally because the return on investment is no longer worth it.

reviews.title: Where do I even start?
reviews.text: The game has so many issues. Many of them have been brought to the attention of the developers, only to be met with a generic AI response and never a resolution. This game has MAJOR glitches. Instead of focusing on fixing them, the developers would rather roll out a new activity that causes more glitches to the game and find ways to get you to spend real money. If for any reason the game glitches and rips you off, the resolution is never in comparison to what you lost in gems. You will end up on the losing end. The prizes are so low compared to the price of items in the game. It’s almost impossible to get ahead and be able to enjoy the game. There are some bullies in the game right now, targeting certain designers, who are sucking the fun out of the game completely. Us players have brought so many things to developers attention to make the game better and they always fall on deaf ears. The devs do not care about our feedback as players, who have spent a lot of money playing. We are tired of asking. I don’t really play much anymore, due to the fact that I feel the devs are greedy and our opinions do not matter. We are tired of feeling unheard, taken advantage of, and dismissed.

reviews.title: Love the game but issues are making me rethink keeping it
reviews.text:
I think this is the first review I have posted. I love this game. I’ve been sucked in to checking in often and spending a lot of time putting together outfits. I’ve even started creating my own clothes. 
However, I have two complaints that are making me rethink keeping the game. 
1. There are too many challenges recently that you have to pick between pieces that are all horrible. They are not created well or are something I would never choose to use again. I try not to buy (you earn money and gems to buy more pieces or you can purchase more in the store).  I do not like to pay the higher prices for things I will never use again. 
Yes, I can choose not to take part in that challenge, but the more you play, the more you earn, and the more parts of the game you can access. 
2. This happens especially when I am voting….  The game will freeze and often say there is no WiFi. I’m sitting right next to the router, and my internet connection is strong on my phone. It is frustrating to have to close out and have to restart.
